title: Siemens wins order for first HVDC link between Great Britain and Denmark
version: Siemens Gas and Power release, 26 August 2019

passages.locator: Opening paragraphs and Cross-border interconnectors in the United Kingdom and Denmark
passages.note: Siemens reports its converter contract for the two Viking Link stations, covering design, supply, installation and commissioning. Under the order, the stations were specified to use Siemens HVDC PLUS voltage-source modular multilevel converters.
